The '''''X & Y'' arc''' (Japanese: '''Ｘ・Ｙ編''' ''X & Y arc''), also referred to as '''''The 12th Chapter''''' (Japanese: '''第十二章''' ''The Twelfth Chapter''), is the twelfth story arc of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}. It began serialization in October 2013, and ended in November 2016. 

This arc follows the adventures of {{adv|X}} and {{adv|Y}}, who travel throughout the [[Kalos]] region after their hometown of {{to|Vaniville}} gets destroyed by a battle between [[Xerxer|Xerneas]] and {{p|Yveltal}}. Together with their friends {{adv|Shauna}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Trevor}}, they start uncovering a conspiracy concocted by the mysterious [[Team Flare]] and are forced to intervene in their plans to use the ancient [[ultimate weapon]] to kill everyone in Kalos.

== Terminology ==
{{main|Terminology of Pokémon Adventures}}
This arc gets its name from the [[Core series|core series games]], [[Pokémon X and Y]].

===Mini-volumes===
====Japan====
{{main|List of Pokémon Adventures XY volumes}}
Due to it taking several years before the arc is collected into a volume, the ''X & Y'' arc of Pokémon Adventures will be separately collected into mini-volumes. The chapters included in these mini-volumes will only be ones that were published in the CoroCoro Ichiban magazine. Once the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}} ended in the regular volumes, the ''X & Y'' arc started to be collected in that format as well. The [[Pokémon Adventures XY volume 1|first volume]] was released on April 28, 2014, which ended after six volumes with the final volume released on December 28, 2016.

These volumes have also been localized in English by [[Shogakukan Asia]] and in {{pmin|France|European French}} by Kurokawa.

====United States====
{{main|List of Pokémon XY volumes}}
An English translation of the ''X & Y'' arc was released by [[VIZ Media]] under the title '''Pokémon XY'''. Despite that the magazine version is also being released in mini-volumes in Japan, VIZ Media's volumes are unique from these, and only contain about three or four chapters each, much like their previous {{MangaArc|Black & White}} [[List of Pokémon Black and White volumes|mini-volumes]]. The series began its run on December 2, 2014, and officially ended after twelve volumes with the final volume released on October 3, 2017.
